title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - Perimeter
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Perimeter. Spatial extent considered as containing: (1) the attributee or attributees of a container, or (2) the generator or generators of a waste flux. Subclass of geo:Feature and saref:FeatureOfInterest (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.2); base class for s4envi:Building, s4envi:City, s4envi:Neighbourhood and s4envi:CollectionOfBuildings, whose own models document only their own additional attributes and inherit this model's attributes, including location, consistsOf and population.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Perimeter'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

location.description: GeoProperty. Geolocation of the perimeter, expressed as a GeoJSON Polygon.

consistsOf.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/consistsOf'. A perimeter consists of the generator(s) of a waste flux (ontology restriction: at least one). Links to WasteProducer entities.

population.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/Population'. Total number of people living within a perimeter.
